chapter: Jazz at the Philharmonic and life on the road
title: Disneyworld townhouse and bassist Louise Davis
summary: At Disneyworld they give her a two-storey townhouse and a car for a two-week stay. She takes only her pianist and works with bassist Louise Davis, whom Dance met in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
